customManagers.description: matchStrings copied verbatim from the customManagers:githubActionsVersions/gitlabPipelineVersions presets (which only scan .github/workflows and .gitlab-ci.yml), so annotations behave the same in the template's .tmpl files. Update together.

packageRules.description: Template updates use build commits, which trigger a patch release (see tool.semantic_release in pyproject.toml) so users get them on copier update.

Template files keep tags rather than digests: a generated project's Renovate pins digests and keeps them current itself. Images on rolling tags like debian:trixie-slim get a new digest on every rebuild, so pinning them here would mean a template release, and a copier update conflict for projects whose Renovate has moved on, each time. GitHub Actions are the exception, below.

Exception to the rule above: template actions are pinned like a generated project's Renovate pins them (helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests), as <sha> # vX.Y.Z. An action's digest only changes with its version (or if upstream moves the tag, which the review rule below catches), so the template and projects move together and copier update merges cleanly. Must stay after the rule above, to override it.
Matched by depName, as the GitLab CI template looks Task up in its apt repo under packageName task
Installed together by install-docker-client.sh, so updated together. Mirrors the rule in meta_template/renovate.json.tmpl.

Template updates that need review: majors can change what generated projects get on copier update, and a digest change on a full-version tag means the tag was moved upstream. Must stay after the automerge rules above, to override their automerge and prConcurrentLimit.
Release template majors as a minor version, listed under Features.
